title: skills(objectstack-automation): the elevated-start limit names only "a button or action" and offers an api flow without its webhook secret cost
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwTZvo7tAGwbbRW2b8

Filing gate: ① a named-site defect in published teaching, the two should-fix findings of the contract review of PR #32915 (card #32832, comment 6839080238) that the PR does not fix. `reach:` an agent following `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` writes metadata that the platform refuses (the review traced both cases to the code on `main`, below).

Blocked-by: #32832
Blocked-by: #32785

**Business reason.** The readonly-field callout (after #32915) tells an agent that a button or action cannot start an elevated `autolaunched` / `record_change` / `schedule` flow and names two routes. (1) The same 403 comes from two more doors the sentence does not name, so an agent that wires a declared endpoint or posts to the trigger route for that flow meets an unexplained 403. (2) One route, "a `screen` or `api` flow declared `runAs: 'system'`", is true at admission, but the same skill teaches that an `api` flow is the inbound-webhook type and needs `secretRef` / `secret` or it is refused at registration and `os validate`; an agent taking that route for a button writes a flow that fails the build, and the remedy then gives an elevated flow a webhook door it never needed. Reader who acts: the `domain:skills` seat (os-dev on `skills/**`, contract-tier build and review); Part 2 may need the lint lane's word.

## Part 1 — name all four doors
`flowStartRefusal` (`packages/runtime/src/flow-start-admission.ts`) is asked at the action door (`action-execution.ts`), the trigger route (`domains/automation.ts`) and declared endpoints (`endpoint-executor.ts`); `os explain flow-update-readonly-field` says "A button, an action, an endpoint or the trigger route". Make the skill sentence say the same. About 34 bytes; the file's token headroom after PR #32841 lands decides the paying cut (same-file restatement only, no ratchet raise).

## Part 2 — the `api` route's cost
Either the sentence (and the Flow Types `api` row) says what an `api` flow costs when its only caller is a button (a secret and an inbound door), so the agent picks the `subflow` route, or the lint explain text stops offering `api` for this case. The second is a lint-lane change of a fix line; ask that lane before choosing it, and keep the skill in the explain text's words.

## Acceptance
- The sentence names the four doors in the explain text's words; the `api` route either carries its cost or is dropped in step with the explain text.
- `check-skills-token-ratchet`, `check-skill-line-ratchet`, spec `check:skill-docs` / `check:skill-refs` green; changeset `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: none.

Dedupe (open AND closed): `is:issue objectstack-automation runAs system button endpoint` → #32832 (this card's parent, closes with PR #32915) and #32666 (the p0 decision); neither covers the two gaps. **New.**
